name: Sri Ram Mandir
town_description: Karnal, traditionally linked to the Mahabharata warrior Karna, is a major city on the Grand Trunk Road (NH-44) in northern Haryana, between Delhi and Chandigarh. It is an agricultural trade hub known for its grain market, the National Dairy Research Institute, and the Karna Lake tourist complex. The city hosts a mix of historic and modern neighbourhood temples and has grown rapidly as an industrial and educational centre.

travel.airport: Chandigarh International Airport (~135 km) or IGI Airport Delhi (~130 km) (verify)
travel.road: Karnal lies on NH-44 (Grand Trunk Road); Sector 5 is accessible by local road and auto-rickshaw
